title: 3rd Point: The Necessity of Prophethood from Beauty and Art in the Universe

questions.question: What does the verse in this part tell people to do if they love Allah?
questions.answer: They should follow the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What is seen in the universe that starts the main idea of this part?
questions.answer: Beautiful art and beauty in created things.

questions.question: What does beautiful design in creation show about the Maker?
questions.answer: It shows that the Maker wants beauty and adornment.

questions.question: When the passage says the Maker loves the perfections in His art, what does that mean in simple words?
questions.answer: Allah loves the perfect beauty and excellence in what He creates.

questions.question: Which created being is named as the most aware and complete?
questions.answer: The human being.

questions.question: Why are human beings given a special place in this passage?
questions.answer: Because they are aware, wide in understanding, and can know and worship Allah.

questions.question: In the passage, what picture is used for human beings in creation?
questions.answer: They are described like the fruit of a tree.

questions.question: Why is the fruit important in that picture?
questions.answer: Because it gathers much of what the tree produces and stands at the far end.

questions.question: Among people, who is described as the highest and brightest one?
questions.answer: The one with the widest understanding and awareness.

questions.question: What does that highest person do with his understanding?
questions.answer: He uses it to worship Allah, notice His art, and thank Him for His blessings.

questions.question: What are the two big “spheres” or areas mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: One is the sphere of Allah’s ruling and art, and the other is the sphere of worship, thought, thanks, and belief.

questions.question: What does the second sphere do in relation to the first sphere?
questions.answer: It serves it strongly and acts in its name.

questions.question: What does this close connection show about the leader of the second sphere?
questions.answer: It shows he is very close to Allah and loved by Him.

questions.question: Why does the passage say it would not make sense for the Maker to ignore this servant?
questions.answer: Because Allah cares even for small tastes, so He would not ignore His most beautiful servant who praises and thanks Him.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah would do for such a servant?
questions.answer: He would speak to him and make him His Messenger.

questions.question: Who is that Messenger in this passage?
questions.answer: Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: Which religion is named as the religion accepted by Allah?
questions.answer: Islam.

questions.question: What is the promise in the verse at the start of this section for people who follow the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: Allah will love them.

questions.question: What does the passage say is clearly found all through the universe?
questions.answer: Beauty and fine art.

questions.question: If creation is full of beauty, what does that tell us about its Maker?
questions.answer: The Maker creates with beauty on purpose.

questions.question: What two things do the beautiful forms of creatures show about the Maker?
questions.answer: A will to make things beautiful and a strong desire to decorate them.

questions.question: If the Maker loves beauty in His creation, toward whom would that love be greatly turned, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Toward human beings.

questions.question: Why are human beings picked out from the rest of creation here?
questions.answer: Because they are the most aware and complete among beings.

questions.question: What simple example does the passage use to explain the place of human beings in creation?
questions.answer: A fruit on a tree.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the fruit compared with the rest of the tree?
questions.answer: It is the most complete part and has a broad view.

questions.question: Among all humans, what kind of person would be the most excellent?
questions.answer: The one with the widest understanding and deepest awareness.

questions.question: What important meeting is mentioned for that excellent person?
questions.answer: He meets with and is addressed by the Beautiful Maker.

questions.question: Name two things that person does for Allah.
questions.answer: He worships Allah and gives thanks for blessings.

questions.question: What is the first signboard or sphere like?
questions.answer: It is a grand, ordered display of rule and art.

questions.question: What is the second signboard or sphere like?
questions.answer: It is bright worship, thinking, admiration, thanks, and belief.

questions.question: How are the two spheres connected?
questions.answer: The second one serves the first one with all its strength.

questions.question: What does this service tell us about the leader of the second sphere?
questions.answer: He is near to Allah and accepted by Him.

questions.question: What reason is given that Allah would not leave this servant without speaking to him?
questions.answer: He praises Allah greatly and thanks Him in a way that fills the world.

questions.question: What final truth is stated about Muhammad, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: He is the Messenger of Allah.

questions.question: According to the verse here, what should a person do to show love for Allah?
questions.answer: Follow the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What important claim does this section make about the Prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: It says the beauty in the universe proves his messengership.

questions.question: What in the universe is used as evidence in this argument?
questions.answer: The beauty and fine design of created things.

questions.question: What does fine beauty in creatures tell us about the One who made them?
questions.answer: He chooses beauty and loves to make things lovely.

questions.question: If the Maker loves the beauty of His works, who would receive special attention from Him?
questions.answer: Human beings, especially the best among them.

questions.question: Why are humans called the fruit of creation in this section?
questions.answer: Because they are the conscious result and most complete part.

questions.question: What special ability of humans is stressed more than once?
questions.answer: Wide understanding and awareness.

questions.question: What kind of human is described as the brightest and highest?
questions.answer: The one whose understanding is the broadest and most universal.

questions.question: What is this great human supposed to do with that gift?
questions.answer: Use it fully for worship, reflection on Allah’s art, and thankfulness.

questions.question: What does the first sphere show?
questions.answer: Allah’s rule and beautiful artistry.

questions.question: What does the second sphere show?
questions.answer: Worship, thinking, admiration, thanks, and faith.

questions.question: Which sphere works in the name of the other?
questions.answer: The second sphere works in the name of the first.

questions.question: Who is the leader of the second sphere being pointed to?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: How does the passage describe his worship and praise?
questions.answer: As very strong and far-reaching, filling land and sea with thanks and exaltation.

questions.question: What question does the passage ask about Allah’s care?
questions.answer: It asks how Allah could care for small details yet ignore His best servant.

questions.question: What answer does the passage give to that question?
questions.answer: It says that would be impossible.

questions.question: What two final statements close this section?
questions.answer: That Islam is the religion with Allah, and Muhammad is Allah’s Messenger.

questions.question: In the opening verse of this part, what comes after loving Allah?
questions.answer: Following the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What would happen from Allah if people do that?
questions.answer: Allah would love them.

questions.question: What does the passage say we can observe in the universe?
questions.answer: Beautiful art and decoration.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect beauty in creation to the Prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: Because beauty points to a Maker who loves beauty and would choose a special messenger.

questions.question: What does the beauty of creatures show about the Maker’s will?
questions.answer: That He wills beauty and adornment.

questions.question: What does that will for beauty show about the Maker’s inner meaning, as explained here?
questions.answer: That He has love and care for the excellence shown in His works.

questions.question: Which part of creation would be the main place for that love to turn?
questions.answer: Human beings.

questions.question: What makes humans stand out in this passage?
questions.answer: They are conscious and complete.

questions.question: Why is a fruit used as an example for the human being?
questions.answer: Because the fruit gathers much from the tree and is a complete outcome.

questions.question: What kind of person among humans is chosen as the top example?
questions.answer: The one with the broadest sight and understanding.

questions.question: What three things does that person do for Allah?
questions.answer: He worships, appreciates Allah’s art, and gives thanks.

questions.question: What is shown in the first great sphere?
questions.answer: Beautiful order, rule, and crafted art.

questions.question: What is shown in the second great sphere?
questions.answer: Worship, reflection, admiration, gratitude, and belief.

questions.question: What job does the second sphere have?
questions.answer: It serves the first sphere.

questions.question: What does serving the first sphere tell us about its leader?
questions.answer: He is very close to Allah and beloved by Him.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that the Maker even considers tastes of the mouth?
questions.answer: To show that Allah cares about details and would care even more about His best worshipping servant.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah certainly would do for this servant?
questions.answer: Speak to him and appoint him as Messenger.

questions.question: What religion and what messenger are named at the end?
questions.answer: Islam and Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What instruction is given to people who say they love Allah?
questions.answer: They should follow the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What sign in the world is used to support the message of this section?
questions.answer: The beauty and artistry in the universe.

questions.question: If a painting is beautiful, we know the painter meant to make it beautiful. What similar idea is taught here about creation?
questions.answer: Since creation is beautiful, its Maker wanted beauty in it.

questions.question: What else besides beauty is mentioned about created things?
questions.answer: They are finely decorated and carefully shaped.

questions.question: What do these beautiful created things teach about the Maker’s love?
questions.answer: That He loves the perfection in His art.

questions.question: According to the passage, which creature would be the main focus of such love?
questions.answer: The human being.

questions.question: Why is the human being called the conscious fruit?
questions.answer: Because humans are aware and are like the final result of creation.

questions.question: What kind of human being is singled out as the best one?
questions.answer: The one with the greatest understanding and awareness.

questions.question: What relationship does this best person have with the Maker?
questions.answer: He meets with the Maker and is spoken to by Him.

questions.question: How does this person use his mind and awareness?
questions.answer: For worship, noticing Allah’s art, and thanking Him.

questions.question: What does the first signboard point to?
questions.answer: Allah’s rule and the beauty of His making.

questions.question: What does the second signboard point to?
questions.answer: Worship, reflection, admiration, gratitude, and faith.

questions.question: Which signboard helps and serves the other one?
questions.answer: The second serves the first.

questions.question: What does this tell us about the one leading the second signboard?
questions.answer: He is serving Allah’s purposes and is loved by Allah.

questions.question: What kind of voice or praise does the passage describe from this servant?
questions.answer: Strong praise, admiration, and thanks that spread very widely.

questions.question: What conclusion is reached about whether Allah would leave such a servant without a message?
questions.answer: He would never leave him without speaking to him.

questions.question: What role is given to Muhammad, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: He is made Allah’s Messenger.

questions.question: What is the religion with Allah named in this passage?
questions.answer: Islam.

questions.question: What does the verse teach about loving Allah in a real way?
questions.answer: Real love for Allah means following the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What reward is mentioned for following him?
questions.answer: Allah’s love.

questions.question: What feature of the universe is described as certain and clearly seen?
questions.answer: Its beauty and artistry.

questions.question: How does the passage move from beauty in the universe to the idea of a messenger?
questions.answer: It says a Maker who loves beauty would choose a best servant to know Him and show thanks.

questions.question: What do lovely forms and decorations in creatures show about the Maker?
questions.answer: That He wants beauty and adornment.

questions.question: What deeper meaning about the Maker is drawn from that?
questions.answer: That He loves the excellence shown in His works.

questions.question: To whom is this love said to turn most strongly?
questions.answer: To the human being.

questions.question: What title is given to the human being in the picture of creation?
questions.answer: The fruit of the tree of creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the fruit’s view and awareness?
questions.answer: It has a broad view and wide consciousness.

questions.question: Among all people, who is the one most fit for the highest place?
questions.answer: The person with the fullest understanding and awareness.

questions.question: What is that person meant to spend his life doing?
questions.answer: Worshipping Allah, seeing His art, and thanking Him.

questions.question: What is the first of the two spheres described in this section?
questions.answer: A grand sphere showing rule and beautiful art.

questions.question: What is the second sphere described in this section?
questions.answer: A bright sphere of worship, thought, admiration, thanks, and belief.

questions.question: How does the second sphere relate to the first?
questions.answer: It works for it and in its name.

questions.question: What can we understand from this about the leader of the second sphere?
questions.answer: He is close to Allah and dear to Him.

questions.question: Why would it be unreasonable for the Maker to ignore that leader?
questions.answer: Because Allah cares for even small details and this servant turns to Him with great worship and praise.

questions.question: What two things does the passage say Allah would surely do for him?
questions.answer: Speak to him and make him His Messenger.

questions.question: State the two ending truths in simple words.
questions.answer: Islam is the true religion with Allah, and Muhammad, peace be upon him, is Allah’s Messenger.
